E_LANG_REQUIRED: Report language is not set. Pass --lang pl|en or set lang in the profile; only doctor runs without it.
E_CASE_EXISTS: A case already exists in this directory; init never overwrites it. Use a new directory or change the profile through an audited update.
E_PROFILE_MISSING: case.json not found in the case directory. Run init first.
E_PROFILE_INVALID: Profile field invalid or not allowed: {field}.
E_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED: Deployment context 'judicial' (court, arbitration, ADR) is not supported in v1.
E_HIGH_RISK_ACK: High-risk deployment context requires deployer_ack in the profile.
E_LEVEL_C_REQUIRED: Model processing is not allowed for this case. Case files are already in the agent environment at level A/B, so the analysis must run at level C, outside the agent session.
